result:
Fixed #1070 and committed locally as 1ea52a92; it is not pushed, since the driver runs the full suite and pushes.

- **Cause:** a by-value parameter that wasn't a number, `bool` or `char` was always treated as data owned by the call. So putting a field-less enum into a struct that also holds a view was refused with NK2302.
- **Fix:** a new check, `rsrc_textless` in `views.nika`, decides whether a type holds nothing a view could point into. That is true for a scalar, or for a struct or enum declared in the same program whose fields are all such types. A by-value parameter of such a type is no longer treated as a view source.
- **Still refused:** `String`, a struct with a `String` field, tuples, generic types, types declared outside the program, and recursive types are handled as before. NK2302 stays wherever a view of one of them is handed back.
- **Side case left alone:** a struct with a `String` field passed by value and handed back whole is still refused, even though no view of it escapes. The brief didn't ask for it, so I didn't touch it.

**Tests:**
- The new test `tests/compiler/tests/by_value_enum_beside_a_view` covers the brief's probe plus a struct of an enum and an `i64`. It prints `hello hello 2`, and the unfixed binary fails it with NK2302.
- `tests/compiler --both-settings`: 479 passed.
- `packages/yaml`: 16 passed.
- The Rust view and NK2302 tests (`text_views`, `stored_views`, `tethers`, `views_kept`, `result_source`, `keeps`, `accepted`) and `fmt::every_nika_file`: 191 passed.
- `nikaia-std` unit tests: 239 passed.
- `cargo fmt`, `pre-push-check.sh` and clippy on this machine's Rust 1.97: all clean.
- I did not run clippy on Rust 1.99.1, the version CI uses: it would need a new toolchain and a separate build, and only 7.3 GB of disk is free. The Rust part of the change is only the regenerated `lowered/views.rs`.

**Changelog (for the version raise):** A by-value parameter whose type holds no text (a field-less enum, or a struct or enum of only such fields and scalars) is no longer taken as the source of a view handed back, so building a view-holding struct from it is no longer refused NK2302.

**Disk:** the test cache `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 3.7 GB, with 7.3 GB free on `/`. One new cache entry over 100 MB was created in this run: `run-bundle/3f8b93b88f7f213d`, 364 MB.

done 1ea52a92, report /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/yaml/y24-1070-by-value-enum-not-a-view.md.report.md
